sections.label: TOOL CALL: python
sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
seg = current_frame.segmentation
nodes = seg['nodes']

# Find player position
player = None
for n in nodes:
    if n['color'] == 'Y':
        player = n
        break

# Find sky blue regions
sky_nodes = [n for n in nodes if n['color'] == 'S']
print(f"Player at: {player['boundary'][:2]}")
print(f"Sky blue regions: {len(sky_nodes)}")

# Try clicking on the player
result = action([{'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': 39, 'col': 22}], intent='solve')
print(f"After clicking player: done={result.get('done')}, level_completed={result.get('level_completed')}")

seg = current_frame.segmentation
nodes = seg['nodes']
green_nodes = [n for n in nodes if n['color'] == 'N']
print(f"Green blocks: {len(green_nodes)}")

# Check if anything changed
for n in nodes:
    if n['color'] in ['Y', 'b', 'S', 'N']:
        boundary = n['boundary']
        rows = [p[0] for p in boundary]
        cols = [p[1] for p in boundary]
        center_row = sum(rows) // len(rows)
        center_col = sum(cols) // len(cols)
        print(f"  {n['color']}: center=({center_row}, {center_col}), pixels={n['pixels']}")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
